inputs.text: [excited] STEG… oh… SOR… us. [curious] In Greek, "stego" means roof.
[happily] Yep — the scientist who found it thought its big plates lay flat on its back, [amazed] like roof tiles. [calm] It lived in North America and Europe, a hundred fifty-five million years ago.
[curious] Were they lying flat, its plates?
[confident] Nope! [pauses] Scientists later discovered they stood up straight, running along the whole length of its back.
